name: Bulk Image Audit — review-screen UI
narrative: An NM reviewing FLW MUAC photos can now zoom into any image to read the tape before passing or failing it

nadia.intro: Nadia reviews the MUAC photos her field workers submit and marks each pass or fail. To judge a borderline reading she needs to see the tape clearly.
nadia.name: Nadia Bello

scenes.title: Zoom into one photo to read the tape
